programme.title: Brace For Impact - Indagine Ad Alta Quota
programme.desc: Tensione alle stelle in questo thriller che vede l'esperta di disastri aerei Sofia coinvolta in un'indagine per far chiarezza sulle reali cause di un tragico incidente in cui ha perso la vita il fratello. Il suo desiderio di giustizia la porterà a infrangere le regole del servizio di intelligence e a scoprire un complotto terroristico.

programme.title: End Of The World

programme.title: BizTalk | AI talent race and the future of work
programme.desc: As artificial intelligence (AI) transforms industries worldwide, competition in AI is increasingly driven not only by technology, but also by talent, skills and workforce development. In this episode of BizTalk, CGTN's Lily Lyu speaks with industry leaders and universities, to explore how AI is reshaping talent demand across industries, and how China is building a broader AI talent pipeline for the future.

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO
programme.desc: In a Dai village called "Manluanzhan" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm? In Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

From Guangzhou's rising low-altitude economy powered by electric flying cars, to Xiamen's practical path toward zero-carbon urban life, we see how innovation is changing the way people live and cities grow. Join BizTalk as we team up with the World Economic Forum, bringing together leaders from WEF, CATL, and Schneider Electric to explore how AI is being driven by real business needs, and how it’s redefining the future of intelligent manufacturing.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing
programme.desc: From the local delicacies of Beijing's Ox Street to latest hangouts and contemporary cuisine of the Chinese capital, hosts Tianran He and Eva May will give you a true taste of Beijing, and the fascinating stories and people behind them.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing's Hutongs
programme.desc: The Hutongs in Beijing are considered the city's blood vessels, as these traditional alleyways make up the DNA of the capital for its rich history and culture. In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May zigzag their way through the Hutongs and the Forbidden City for a mouth-watering experience full of ancient and modern delicacies. Starring German designer Katrin, Russian artist Liuba and photographer Feng Yu from Beijing, our hosts are taking you along a journey that features fried noodles, dim sum, pancakes and co.!

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called "bowl music.” The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: Shunde's flavors: where tradition blends with vivid daily life
programme.desc: Shunde, a gastronomic gem in the Pearl River Delta, neighboring Hong Kong, uses masterful craft and sincere heart to transform local treasures – from crispy fish skin to fried milk – into culinary wonders. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia, are setting out to taste the flavors and feel the warmth of Shunde's countryside with the locals.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, traveling to the cities of Zhuzhou and Xiangtan to meet another group of extraordinary women. By capturing snippets of the lives and work of an electric locomotive designer, a flight instructor, a painter, and a poverty alleviation volunteer, we showcase the unique cultural and humanistic charm of this region.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, we arrive in Changsha — the economic and cultural hub of Hunan Province, and a core city in the Yangtze River Middle Reaches Economic Zone. Our lens turns to the "Xiangjiang Ladies" who work in Changsha’s high-tech and equipment manufacturing sectors. Their daily lives and professional endeavors reflect the city’s innovative vitality, while their after-work gatherings also showcase the dazzling night views along both banks of the Xiangjiang River, highlighting Changsha’s distinct charm as a vibrant capital of leisure and entertainment.

programme.title: China's Ancient “Wall Street”: Pingyao
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Pingyao – the ancient "Wall Street" of China and a historic banking hub. Enclosed by ancient city walls and seemingly frozen in time, this entire city, together with two nearby ancient temples, offers a one-of-a-kind adventure at this UNESCO World Heritage Site!

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.3
programme.desc: Hainan- the anchor-point of China's southern frontier, its islands custodians of the vast South China Sea! And perhaps nothing embodies the allure of the oceanic wonderland more than the limpid waters of Sansha. From volcanic northern shores to cutting-edge modern cities, join us on coastal journey dotted with historic lighthouses illuminating a fascinating past and guiding the way to a promising future...

programme.title: Shunde's flavors: where tradition blends with vivid daily life
programme.desc: Shunde, a gastronomic gem in the Pearl River Delta, neighboring Hong Kong, uses masterful craft and sincere heart to transform local treasures – from crispy fish skin to fried milk – into culinary wonders. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia, are setting out to taste the flavors and feel the warmth of Shunde's countryside with the locals.

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Five Ancestors Fist
programme.desc: In Quanzhou, southeast China, Kleber seeks out masters of the Five Ancestors Fist, a combination of five local kungfu styles. He meets the abbot of a Southern Shaolin Temple, and takes part in the extraordinary training regime used by Shaolin monks to hone their bodies and minds. He experiences the intricacies of Quanzhou’s traditional puppetry, and learns how Five Ancestors Fist incorporated military tactics that allowed its practitioners to band together and fight off pirates.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: White Crane
programme.desc: In Yongchun, China, Kleber explores the origins of White Crane kungfu and its effect on the martial arts world. He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

programme.title: Foodwise: Changsha
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May embark on a journey to Changsha in Hunan Province.?They taste their way through the local cuisine, discover the city's latest art and fashion trends, and find out why this place is one of China's "influencer hotspots", attracting millions of domestic and foreign tourists each year.

programme.title: Foodwise：Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and interesting guest appearances. From drinking beer with a German friend, catching crabs by the ocean and devouring grilled eel the classic Korean way, this episode will leave you hungry for more!

programme.title: Yangliuqing New Year Painting Art
programme.desc: On May 20, 2006, Yangliuqing New Year Paintings were named as part of China’s national intangible cultural heritage. The New Year painting tradition can be traced back many centuries, to the Ming Dynasty and beyond, reaching the height of its popularity in the Qing Dynasty. There are no restrictions on the themes of the paintings, and there is no blessing they cannot convey. Yangliuqing New Year Paintings are loved all over the country for their beautiful details and vivid colors—but most of all, for the good wishes they impart to anyone who sees them.

programme.title: Village Voyage: Discover Shunde's hidden gems-乡观中国5 预告片浅尝烟火 漫赏村光
programme.desc: What does rural China have to offer? That's a question worth exploring! In this episode of Village Voyage, CGTN's Julian Waghann teams up with Absalom Absalom, a traveler from Namibia, as they journey through the ancient villages of Shunde District in Guangzhou: Yang'e Village, Bijiang Village, and Fengjian Water Town. These villages lie in Lingnan, a historical and cultural region in southern China that spans Guangdong, Guangxi, and beyond. Known for its subtropical climate, bustling trade ports, and distinctive Cantonese culture, Lingnan has long been a place where tradition and openness coexist. Together, they wander through lively markets, uncovering the flavors that define Shunde's cuisine. They step into the world of intangible cultural heritage and experience the spirit of "mastery in both culture and martial arts." They also immerse themselves in the beauty of Lingnan, where interwoven waterways and classical gardens reveal a seamless blend of nature and culture. From village lanes to time-honored traditions, witness the vibrant new energy of rural life rising amid the everyday charm of Lingnan.

programme.title: Navigating the Hills of Chongqing
programme.desc: This episode explores the transportation ingenuity of Chongqing, the Fog City. Surrounded by mountains and rivers, this megacity solves topographic challenges with the Yangtze River Cableway, Asia's second-longest escalator, and a train passing through a building. From the dock culture at the confluence of two rivers to a logistics hub linking China and Europe, witness its transformation from an inland town to an economic center via the Go West policy.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 1
programme.desc: As Hainan moves towards implementing its special customs operation, CGTN’s Travelogue is launching a brand-new series, “Fun Guide to China”. Set in Hainan, the pilot episode journeys through its cities, mountains, coastlines and rainforests, capturing the vibrant atmosphere of life in the Free Trade Port.From the world’s largest stand-alone duty-free mall – a true shopper’s paradise, to the laid-back charm of an “Old Dad Tea” restaurant, host Tianran He explores the evolving cityscape of Haikou. On the northeast coast in Wenchang, he joins a local photographer to witness the launch of a Chinese space rocket, before diving into interactive space museums that bring the cosmos within reach. The journey then heads west to Danzhou, where campervans and “mermaids” share the same stage, before reaching Wanning on the east coast, where Tianran catches waves at one of China’s most famous surfing hotspots.

programme.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.1: Old Gems
programme.desc: Xiamen, a key starting point of China’s ancient Maritime Silk Road, is one of China’s most livable cities. In this episode, host Min-Zhui Lee and co-host Pan William, an honorary citizen of Xiamen and a professor, take you on an immersive journey through the city. Explore Xiamen University, renowned as China’s most beautiful university campus, and visit Wanshi Park, known as “China’s First Lawn”. Trace Xiamen’s history through its streets, admiring the arcades that tell the stories of the city’s early commercial development. Finally, board a boat to Gulangyu Islet, the “Island of Music” — the birthplace of modern music education in China, and a living “World Architecture Museum”. Every corner of this islet lets you experience the past and present of Xiamen’s vibrant life.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.4
programme.desc: Shaanxi, almost right in the middle of China, is a true land of contrasts. South of the Qinling Mountains that divide the province, the terrain has all the allure of south China, while north of this great dividing range lies the Guanzhong Plain and the austere and otherworldly Loess Plateau. Join us for a journey into a province that presents two equally beautiful and fascinating faces to the world!

programme.title: The Great Wall Homestay
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, Tianran He's heading to the mountains on Beijing’s northern outskirts, to meet some people his age who have swapped city life for the chance to run guesthouses beside the Great Wall of China.

programme.title: A Village Homestay in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, our presenter Tianran He’s heading out of Beijing proper, to the city’s Miyun District. There he’ll meet some people running guesthouses who gave up their day jobs, in order to achieve the dream of a place of their own in the country.

From the dock culture at the confluence of two rivers to a logistics hub linking China and Europe, witness its transformation from an inland town to an economic center via the Go West policy.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 1
programme.desc: As Hainan moves towards implementing its special customs operation, CGTN’s Travelogue is launching a brand-new series, “Fun Guide to China”. Set in Hainan, the pilot episode journeys through its cities, mountains, coastlines and rainforests, capturing the vibrant atmosphere of life in the Free Trade Port.From the world’s largest stand-alone duty-free mall – a true shopper’s paradise, to the laid-back charm of an “Old Dad Tea” restaurant, host Tianran He explores the evolving cityscape of Haikou. On the northeast coast in Wenchang, he joins a local photographer to witness the launch of a Chinese space rocket, before diving into interactive space museums that bring the cosmos within reach. The journey then heads west to Danzhou, where campervans and “mermaids” share the same stage, before reaching Wanning on the east coast, where Tianran catches waves at one of China’s most famous surfing hotspots.

programme.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.1: Old Gems
programme.desc: Xiamen, a key starting point of China’s ancient Maritime Silk Road, is one of China’s most livable cities. In this episode, host Min-Zhui Lee and co-host Pan William, an honorary citizen of Xiamen and a professor, take you on an immersive journey through the city. Explore Xiamen University, renowned as China’s most beautiful university campus, and visit Wanshi Park, known as “China’s First Lawn”. Trace Xiamen’s history through its streets, admiring the arcades that tell the stories of the city’s early commercial development. Finally, board a boat to Gulangyu Islet, the “Island of Music” — the birthplace of modern music education in China, and a living “World Architecture Museum”. Every corner of this islet lets you experience the past and present of Xiamen’s vibrant life.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.4
programme.desc: Shaanxi, almost right in the middle of China, is a true land of contrasts. South of the Qinling Mountains that divide the province, the terrain has all the allure of south China, while north of this great dividing range lies the Guanzhong Plain and the austere and otherworldly Loess Plateau. Join us for a journey into a province that presents two equally beautiful and fascinating faces to the world!

programme.title: Village Voyage: Discover Shunde's hidden gems-乡观中国5 预告片浅尝烟火 漫赏村光
programme.desc: What does rural China have to offer? That's a question worth exploring! In this episode of Village Voyage, CGTN's Julian Waghann teams up with Absalom Absalom, a traveler from Namibia, as they journey through the ancient villages of Shunde District in Guangzhou: Yang'e Village, Bijiang Village, and Fengjian Water Town. These villages lie in Lingnan, a historical and cultural region in southern China that spans Guangdong, Guangxi, and beyond. Known for its subtropical climate, bustling trade ports, and distinctive Cantonese culture, Lingnan has long been a place where tradition and openness coexist. Together, they wander through lively markets, uncovering the flavors that define Shunde's cuisine. They step into the world of intangible cultural heritage and experience the spirit of "mastery in both culture and martial arts." They also immerse themselves in the beauty of Lingnan, where interwoven waterways and classical gardens reveal a seamless blend of nature and culture. From village lanes to time-honored traditions, witness the vibrant new energy of rural life rising amid the everyday charm of Lingnan.

programme.title: The Great Wall Homestay
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, Tianran He's heading to the mountains on Beijing’s northern outskirts, to meet some people his age who have swapped city life for the chance to run guesthouses beside the Great Wall of China.

programme.title: A Village Homestay in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, our presenter Tianran He’s heading out of Beijing proper, to the city’s Miyun District. There he’ll meet some people running guesthouses who gave up their day jobs, in order to achieve the dream of a place of their own in the country.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: White Crane
programme.desc: In Yongchun, China, Kleber explores the origins of White Crane kungfu and its effect on the martial arts world. He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

programme.title: Foodwise: Changsha
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May embark on a journey to Changsha in Hunan Province.?They taste their way through the local cuisine, discover the city's latest art and fashion trends, and find out why this place is one of China's "influencer hotspots", attracting millions of domestic and foreign tourists each year.

programme.title: Foodwise：Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and interesting guest appearances. From drinking beer with a German friend, catching crabs by the ocean and devouring grilled eel the classic Korean way, this episode will leave you hungry for more!

programme.title: El triunfo
programme.desc: Barcelona, decada de 1980: en un duro barrio urbano habitado por sobrevivientes y gobernado por exlegionarios -Gandhi, Fontan y Andrade-, quienes luchan una guerra por el control de las calles, Nen y sus amigos Palito, Topo y Tostao sueñan con triunfar en el mundo de la rumba.

Un taxista llamado Leo en Rosario está luchando con su relación y largas horas de trabajo. Un evento inesperado lo obliga a cambiar su rutina, y la ciudad cambiante y situaciones tensas lo llevan al limite.

programme.title: Reus
programme.desc: Una cronica de la lucha de dos familias del crimen por el control del barrio Reus en Montevideo, Uruguay.

programme.title: Las dos vidas de Andrés Rabadán
programme.desc: Está basada en hechos reales y explora la vida de Andrés Rabadán, conocido en la prensa como "el loco de la ballesta".

programme.title: Flor de Azúcar
programme.desc: Un joven campesino se ve obligado a huir después de matar involuntariamente a un guardia abusivo. Después de pasar un año entero escondido en una remota isla de pesca, decide regresar a su campo y reunirse con su esposa e hijas.
Un espectro vuelve para atormentar a aquellos que erradicaron la plaga de la peste 30 años atrás.

programme.title: Filosofía Natural del Amor
programme.desc: Es una reflexión sobre las relaciones, el sexo, la fidelidad, el amor y la muerte.

programme.title: Arpón
programme.desc: El señor Arguello, director de un colegio, debe cuidar a Cata, una alumna de 14 años accidentada en un lago, mientras llegan sus padres. Durante la espera se desatará la historia más importante de sus vidas.

programme.title: Tarzán en Manhattan
programme.desc: Tarzán viaja a Nueva York para rescatar al chimpancé Chita, que ha sido capturado por un malvado experimentador con animales. Allí forma equipo con Jane, taxista e hija de un ex policía detective privado, que ayuda a Tarzán a liberar a Chita y a sus amigos.

programme.title: El Comando
programme.desc: Un agente de la DEA que sufre un trastorno de estrés postraumático debe proteger a su familia de un ataque a su casa después de que un delincuente convicto y sus secuaces vengan a buscar su alijo de millones dentro de la casa del agente.

programme.title: Behewulf: la Leyenda Vikinga
programme.desc: Dinamarca, siglo VI. El rey danés Hrothgar y sus guerreros matan a un trol cuyo hijo, Grendel, jura vengarse.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Es el Blitz de Londres en 1940. Un anciano y enfermo Dr. John Watson cuenta a su enfermera la historia de su investigación más compleja con Sherlock Holmes, que ambos juraron que nunca se contaría al público ni se adaptaría a una de las famosas historias de Watson.

programme.title: Rabia
programme.desc: Una mujer desarrolla el gusto por la sangre humana después de una cirugía plástica experimental, y sus víctimas se convierten en zombis sedientos de sangre, lo que lleva a una epidemia en toda la ciudad.

programme.title: Ace Bodyguard
programme.desc: Esta película cuenta la historia de Zhang Han, un guardaespaldas de élite «retirado», que une fuerzas con su antiguo compañero para rescatar a su esposa secuestrada.

programme.title: La espada del asesino
programme.desc: Nguyen Vu es el único sobreviviente de su familia que fue ejecutada por la emperatriz de Vietnam. Descubre que tal atrocidad fue motivada tras ser acusados por delitos que no cometieron y se propone hacer justicia y limpiar su nombre.

programme.title: Bermuda Tentacles
programme.desc: Cuando el Air Force One se hunde en el Triángulo de las Bermudas, la Marina envía a su mejor equipo de rescate. Pero al rescatar al presidente, el equipo despierta a una criatura que amenaza a toda la costa este.

programme.title: Blood Lake
programme.desc: Después de devorar a la población de peces, miles de lampreas hambrientas comienzan a atacar a los ciudadanos de una tranquila ciudad lacustre, y la comunidad lucha por mantenerse con vida.

programme.title: En primera línea
programme.desc: Situé au Viêt Nam en avril 1968, trois mois après l'offensive du Têt et un mois après l'assassinat de Martin Luther King Jr, Point Man raconte l'histoire d'une équipe de pompiers de l'armée américaine fracturée par les tensions raciales, les crises morales et les pressions écrasantes du combat dans une guerre que personne ne veut mener. Andre « Casper » Allen, un idéologue brutal, est en désaccord avec Silas Meeks, le mitrailleur de l'escouade, en raison de ses idées radicales. Lorsque leur mission de recherche et de destruction dans le delta du Mékong tourne mal, les deux hommes se retrouvent opposés l'un à l'autre et à leur chef de section récalcitrant, le lieutenant Sutter. Les hommes de pointe meurent comme des mouches dans la brousse, et à mesure que les loyautés se dissolvent, chaque pas en avant a un prix.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Mientras un hombre conduce su moto por el desierto, unos matones le roban el vehículo y lo dan por muerto. Sobrevive y ya no piensa en el suicidio, porque ahora tiene un objetivo en la vida: vengarse y recuperar su moto.

programme.title: Gagarin, Pionero del Espacio
programme.desc: El 12 de abril de 1961, el cosmonauta soviético Yuri Gagarin despegó en un cohete Vostok y orbitó alrededor de la Tierra durante 108 minutos. Seleccionado entre más de tres mil pilotos de combate de toda la Unión Soviética, Gagarin tuvo que entrenarse rápidamente para realizar el viaje de su vida.

programme.title: Los Piratas
programme.desc: Una historia épica, que abarca décadas y continentes, sobre Ioannis Varvakis, un bribón de la época de la Ilustración que se puso del lado de los rusos en su guerra de 1768 contra los turcos, se hizo amigo de Catalina la Grande, amasó una fortuna con el caviar y luego lo donó todo para ayudar a su patria a luchar contra el imperio otomano.

programme.title: A Ciegas
programme.desc: Un detective de policía tiene que resolver dos horribles asesinatos. El problema es que su único sospechoso es un ciego.

programme.title: Colapso Global
programme.desc: El caos reina en nuestro planeta, llueve fuego del cielo y las personas deben matar para sobrevivir. Un grupo de habitantes de Pleasent, Washington, liderados por el alcalde, busca un refugio en un lugar elevado. Mientras la Tierra empieza a quebrarse, entre avalanchas, volcanes y motines, la caravana se enfrenta a un viaje por carretera en un paisaje postapocalíptico que nunca olvidarán.

programme.title: Flammes sur la ville
programme.desc: Scott Daniels, ingénieur de la ville de Millwood, venu de Houston, enquête sur une série d'incendies mystérieux. Jesse, le fils unique de Scott et Lourie Harper, qui a détesté le déménagement ou la maison de jeunesse de son père, simule une fièvre et invite sa nouvelle petite amie Carmen.

programme.title: Poursuite Mortelle
programme.desc: Un groupe de cinq alpinistes fait de la randonnée et de l'escalade dans les Highlands écossais lorsqu'il découvre une jeune fille serbe enterrée dans une petite chambre en pleine nature. Ils se retrouvent alors pris dans un terrifiant jeu du chat et de la souris avec les ravisseurs, alors qu'ils tentent de mettre la jeune fille à l'abri.

programme.title: Yeti : Terreur en Montagne
programme.desc: Des amis partent à l'aventure dans la neige et tombent nez à nez avec une créature mortelle.

programme.title: The eXtremists
programme.desc: Une équipe de tournage se rend dans les Alpes autrichiennes, près de l’ancienne frontière yougoslave, pour filmer trois passionnés de sports extrêmes poursuivis par une avalanche pour une publicité. Ce qu’ils ignorent, c’est qu’ils tournent à proximité de la cachette secrète de Slobodan Pavle, un criminel de guerre serbe. L’ayant accidentellement filmé, ils se retrouvent entraînés dans une course-poursuite mortelle à travers les montagnes, mêlant ski, snowboard, parachutisme, rafting, hélicoptères, motos et base jump.

programme.title: Grid Runners
programme.desc: Un scientifique donne vie à des personnages de réalité virtuelle. Deux d'entre eux sont des femmes du site de jeu cybersexe. Le troisième est un guerrier qui veut libérer le reste des méchants du monde souterrain de la réalité virtuelle. Un policier des frontières doit vaincre le guerrier de la réalité virtuelle tout en apprenant à se comporter avec l'une des femmes du cybersexe.

programme.title: Mega Piranha
programme.desc: Une souche mutante de piranhas géants et féroces s'échappe de l'Amazonie et se dirige vers la Floride.

programme.title: Complot Terroriste
programme.desc: "Sebastian Dellacourt, assassin gouvernemental redoutable, rate une mission et finit en prison. Sa seule chance d’en sortir : accepter un dernier contrat. Il doit infiltrer une milice dangereuse dirigée par Arno Taylor, un idéaliste délirant déterminé à renverser le gouvernement américain."

programme.title: King Rising 3
programme.desc: Dominic Purcell se transforme d’un tueur à gages moderne en guerrier médiéval dans cette aventure pleine d’action inspirée de la série de jeux vidéo Dungeon Siege. Découvrez des effets spéciaux époustouflants qui donnent vie à une action ininterrompue. Un tueur à gages est transporté au Moyen Âge, où il doit affronter une armée gigantesque – et un dragon cracheur de feu – dans une bataille acharnée pour survivre !

programme.title: L'Ange Gardien
programme.desc: Après avoir enquêté sur une série de crimes violents, deux inspecteurs de la police de Los Angeles découvrent une nouvelle drogue liée à un pouvoir surnaturel terrifiant.

programme.title: Dragon Warriors
programme.desc: Un sorcier maléfique, Lord Tensley, cherche à obtenir la main et le cœur de la belle princesse, Lady Ennogard. Lorsqu'elle refuse, il l'enferme et libère un dragon mortel, qu'il contrôle, pour terroriser le pays. Il jure que, tant qu'elle n'aura pas accepté son amour, son dragon détruira tous ceux qui oseront montrer le moindre signe d'amour dans le royaume.

programme.title: Desert Strike
programme.desc: Un ancien militaire au passé mystérieux conduit un groupe de réfugiés égyptiens à travers le désert et doit les protéger d'un groupe de mercenaires diaboliques.

programme.title: A Battle of Wits
programme.desc: L'histoire est centrée sur une bataille qui s'est déroulée pendant la période des États combattants en Chine, une série de guerres civiles qui s'est étendue du 5e au 3e siècle avant J.-C. Basée sur un manga japonais populaire, elle était elle-même basée sur un roman japonais inspiré de l'histoire des États combattants en Chine

programme.title: L'Ascension D'un Homme De Main
programme.desc: L'histoire vraie de Carlton Leach, jeune hooligan Anglais qui intègre un des gangs les plus connus du pays à la fin des années 80. Il grimpe alors les échelons au point de devenir le criminel le plus respecté mais aussi détesté. Il devra faire face à ses propres démons lors de cette montée en puissance vers le grand banditisme et tout faire pour éviter la prison.

programme.title: Héritage
programme.desc: Lors d'un voyage de chasse dans la région sauvage isolée, un père et son fils adolescent adoptif sont transformés en proies d'agresseurs inconnus. Ils sont rejoints dans leur lutte pour la survie par un étranger qui révèle la troublante vérité sur le père biologique du fils, un seigneur du crime international, et pourquoi ce seigneur du crime a envoyé des assassins entraînés pour tuer l'adolescent.

programme.title: El angel vengador
programme.desc: Miles Utley es un comando/guardaespaldas mormón profesional que se ve obligado a convertirse en renegado y a cuestionar su fe cuando investiga un escándalo de asesinato y especulación de tierras.

programme.title: Sandokan Alla Riscossa
programme.desc: Tra mari esotici e scontri contro il potere coloniale, Sandokan torna a combattere per la libertà del suo popolo, tra arrembaggi e duelli.

programme.title: La Balada de Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: Un gángster supuestamente muerto quiere implicar a un hombre completamente inocente para que pague por sus crímenes y así poder dar esquinazo a sus vengadores y perseguidores.

programme.title: La Rivolta Dei Mercenari
programme.desc: In un territorio sconvolto dalla ribellione, un gruppo di spietati mercenari viene ingaggiato per reprimere una rivolta, ma tradimenti e ambizioni personali accendono una lotta feroce per il potere.

programme.title: El Hombre el orgullo y la venganza
programme.desc: Un incondicional soldado español recurre a la delincuencia para demostrar su amor por una misteriosa y promiscua gitana.

programme.title: Golia Alla Conquista Di Bagdad
programme.desc: Tra intrighi di corte, battaglie e colpi di scena, Golia affronta nemici e tradimenti per salvare Baghdad e difendere il regno. Diretto da Domenico Paolella.

programme.title: El último hijo
programme.desc: Un forajido intenta acabar con su descendencia eliminando a su malvada línea consanguínea.

programme.title: Afrodite, Dea Dell'amore
programme.desc: Tra passioni proibite, intrighi di corte e sfide al potere, Afrodite intreccia destino e seduzione nel cuore del mito. Con Anthony Steffen e Isabelle Corey.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: Bonanza - S1 EP19 - Los asesinos a sueldo
programme.desc: Hoss y Little Joe son confundidos con sanguinarios asesinos a sueldo en un pequeño pueblo de Texas dominado por dos familias enemistadas.

programme.title: Maciste Nelle Miniere Del Re Salomone
programme.desc: Tra deserti, miniere segrete e pericoli mortali, Maciste affronta una missione estrema alla ricerca del tesoro perduto.

programme.title: Death Alley
programme.desc: En 1892, la banda de los Dalton se propuso convertirse en los forajidos más famosos de Estados Unidos. Este sueño se convirtió en pesadilla.

programme.title: I Coltelli Del Vendicatore
programme.desc: Tra intrighi e vendetta in un’ambientazione nordica, un uomo combatte contro tradimenti e usurpatori per ristabilire giustizia, tra duelli e colpi di scena. Diretto da Mario Bava e Leopoldo Savona.

programme.title: A Fistful of Lead
programme.desc: Cuatro forajidos del Oeste llevan a cabo un atraco a un banco en Bath Water, un pueblo de la fiebre del oro. Cuando el grupo sale en su persecución, las cosas empeoran, ya que los bandidos se dan cuenta de que han sido traicionados.

programme.title: Giovanni Dalle Bande Nere
programme.desc: Diretto da Sergio Grieco,con protagonista Vittorio Gassman. Nel pieno delle guerre rinascimentali, il valoroso condottiero Giovanni dalle Bande Nere guida le sue truppe tra battaglie e strategie militari, diventando simbolo di coraggio e disciplina.

programme.title: Los McMasters
programme.desc: Cuando un veterano negro de la Guerra Civil se convierte en copropietario del rancho sureño de los McMasters, los indignados veteranos confederados locales vienen a por él y su esposa india.

programme.title: I Dieci Gladiatori
programme.desc: Dieci guerrieri vengono scelti per una missione decisiva tra duelli, intrighi e battaglie che possono cambiare il destino di Roma.

programme.title: Cassidy Red
programme.desc: Cuatro de los forajidos más infames del Oeste llevan a cabo un audaz robo a un banco en la ciudad minera de Bath Water. Mientras la banda es perseguida por la ley, las cosas se complican cuando los bandidos descubren que han sido traicionados, pero ¿por quién?

programme.title: L'assedio Di Siracusa
programme.desc: Tra assedi, strategie e passioni, Siracusa resiste all’avanzata romana in una sfida che decide il destino della città. Con Sylva Koscina.

programme.title: Tierra de alfareros
programme.desc: Un ex confederado intenta empezar de cero en una granja de Texas con su mujer y su hija pequeña. Rápidamente aprende que a veces el pasado no permanece enterrado.

programme.title: La Regina Delle Amazzoni
programme.desc: Con Gianna Maria Canale, in un regno di guerriere leggendarie, intrighi e battaglie accendono la lotta per il potere.

programme.title: Tu Cabeza vale mas de 1000 dolares
programme.desc: Para cumplir el último deseo de su madre, un cazarrecompensas intenta encontrar a su hermanastro, un desertor confederado convertido en delincuente, y entregarlo a la ley.

programme.title: Samoa, Regina Della Giungla
programme.desc: Diretto da Guido Malatesta, con Edwige Fenech.Tra giungle inesplorate e pericoli nascosti, una coraggiosa regina guida il suo popolo contro invasori e tradimenti, tra azione e avventura.

programme.title: Los últimos días de Billy the Kid (VOSTESP)
programme.desc: Esta película narra los últimos días del forajido más emblemático del Oeste.

programme.title: Il Ratto Delle Sabine
programme.desc: Tra rivalità, passioni e battaglie nell’antica Roma, il destino di due popoli si decide in uno scontro che cambierà la storia.

programme.title: El Gran Duelo
programme.desc: Un ex sheriff canoso ayuda a un hombre acusado de asesinato a enfrentarse al poderoso trío de hermanos.

programme.title: Afrodite, Dea Dell'amore
programme.desc: Tra passioni proibite, intrighi di corte e sfide al potere, Afrodite intreccia destino e seduzione nel cuore del mito. Con Anthony Steffen e Isabelle Corey.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Jeb Drummond es un pastor de ovejas asesino que ha tomado a Adam como rehén para intentar obligar a Ben a cederle una gran parte de las tierras de Ponderosa.

programme.title: The Colt
programme.desc: Durante el fragor de la batalla en plena Guerra Civil, nace un potro seductoramente inocente de la querida yegua del soldado Jim Rabb. Rechazando la orden de matarlo para que no se convierta en un estorbo, Rabb se queda con el potro como consuelo en estos tiempos desesperados, un símbolo de esperanza que lleva a los hombres del Primer Arma de Caballería a un viaje de autodescubrimiento y nueva hermandad.

programme.title: Messalina
programme.desc: Con Belinda Lee, Messalina intreccia seduzione e potere nella Roma imperiale tra passioni e congiure.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: El inspector Leduque llega de Nueva Orleans a Virginia City para detener a Ben Cartwright por un asesinato cometido hace 20 años. Cuando Ben declara públicamente que se retira de la carrera por la gobernación, la gente del pueblo se molesta no sólo por esto, sino que Little Joe también ha sido acusado de matar a tiros a sangre fría al ayudante de Leduque.

programme.title: Piena Di Grazia
programme.desc: Dopo la resurrezione, Maria guida i discepoli tra dubbi e speranza custodendo il messaggio destinato a cambiare il mondo.

programme.title: Fuera de la Ley
programme.desc: Tom Carter envía a su hijo Billy a buscar la ayuda del sheriff cuando la granja está siendo atacada por los secuaces del vecino Jon Pryce. Billy regresa, encuentra a su padre asesinado y se dispone a encontrar a los asesinos que contrató Pryce, Black Jack y su banda.

programme.title: Genoveffa Di Brabante - La Lancia Della Vendetta
programme.desc: Accusata ingiustamente di tradimento, Genoveffa viene esiliata e costretta a sopravvivere nei boschi con il figlio, affrontando fame e pericoli mentre la verità cerca di emergere.

programme.title: La Charge des Cosaques
programme.desc: L'histoire de Hadji Murad, un chef tchétchène du XIXe siècle qui a mené ses guerriers dans une lutte contre les forces d'invasion du tsar russe.

programme.title: Amigo!... Mon colt a deux mots à te dire
programme.desc: Un vagabond aux poings rapides et un proxénète armé de pistolets rapides aident un enfant à réclamer son héritage.

programme.title: Vengeance aux deux visages
programme.desc: Après avoir braqué une banque mexicaine, Dad Longworth s'empare du butin et laisse son complice Rio se faire capturer, mais Rio s'échappe et part à la recherche de Dad en Californie.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Ben et Adam sont enfermés en prison, sur le point d'être pendus pour un crime qu'ils n'ont pas commis. Joe et Hoss doivent découvrir pourquoi les témoins du crime présumé se sont parjurés avant que l'exécution n'ait lieu.

programme.title: Le justicier de Dieu
programme.desc: Un ancien tireur devenu prêtre cherche à se venger de trois bandits qui se font passer pour des citoyens respectueux de la loi.

programme.title: Une longue file de croix
programme.desc: Django et Sartana sont des chasseurs de primes qui éliminent des bandits dans une petite ville de l'Ouest. Un méchant propriétaire foncier fait entrer clandestinement des immigrants clandestins et les hommes qui travaillent pour lui payent la tête à un prix exorbitant. Il est donc logique que Django et Sartana passent un appel d'ici peu.

programme.title: Django, le taciturne
programme.desc: La bande de Thompson attaque une caravane ; Bill, témoin involontaire, parvient à s'échapper et à sauver la vie de Linda. Tous deux se réfugient dans le village voisin, c'est-à-dire là où se trouvent les bandits.

programme.title: Son nom est Pote
programme.desc: Après que Pot et son frère Ray aient dévalisé une banque, Pot est arrêté mais parvient à s'échapper. Il rencontre un bandit nommé Steve et ils complotent pour cambrioler une autre banque locale. Avec l'aide d'un croque-mort qui creuse ses tombes à la dynamite, ils réussissent à vider le coffre-fort. Cependant, ce que Pot ne sait pas, c'est que Steve coopère avec Lobo, un bandit mexicain, qui capture Ray afin de s'approprier tout l'argent.

programme.title: El Puro, la rançon est pour toi
programme.desc: Un hors-la-loi alcoolique est mis à l'abri d'une bande de chasseurs de primes sans scrupules par une serveuse compatissante, qu'il va bientôt chercher à venger lorsqu'ils la tuent.

programme.title: Bravo Django
programme.desc: Django Reagan est censé retrouver le coupable d'un vol, après avoir réussi à remettre la main sur l'argent volé. Il part à sa recherche dans le Montana, où la guerre fait rage entre éleveurs et colons.

programme.title: O Cangaceiro
programme.desc: Après avoir pillé et massacré un village, le chef d'une bande de bandits, le capitaine Jagunço, enlève Flô, l'épouse du maire Cisso, et la torture.

programme.title: Les Pirates du Mississipi
programme.desc: Un groupe de pirates menés par Kelly, un bandit habillé tout en noir, sème la terreur en s'en prenant aux habitants de Helena et aux bateaux postiers sur le Mississippi. Le shérif James Lively doit aller contre la méfiance des habitants mais aussi des Indiens. Mais avec l'aide des Cherokees, car les bandits se sont établis sur leurs terres, et de son adjoint Tom Quincy, il parvient à mettre fin à leurs méfaits.

programme.title: Les cavaliers du destin
programme.desc: Le méchant Kincaid contrôle l'approvisionnement local en eau et prévoit de se débarrasser des autres éleveurs. L'agent gouvernemental Saunders se présente sous couverture pour se débarrasser de Kincaid et gagner le cœur d'une de ses victimes, Fay Denton.

programme.title: Le retour de Billy the Kid
programme.desc: Billy the Kid tente de vivre en paix, sous un nouveau nom et dans une ville frontalière, mais il est approché par un prédicateur qui lui demande de l'aider à libérer la ville d'un homme impitoyable et de son tireur.

programme.title: Les Femmes de Jesse James
programme.desc: Jesse James est tellement occupé à courir les jupons que sa carrière de hors-la-loi commence à en pâtir.

programme.title: Les Aigles noirs de Santa Fe
programme.desc: Lorsque les Comanches se mettent sur le sentier de la guerre, les colons se réfugient à Fort Eagle Rock, commandé par le capitaine Jackson. L'agent secret Cliff McPherson arrive dans ce fort en sous-effectif pour donner des conseils et apporter son soutien. Il apprend que les Comanches ont été attisés par Morton, un éleveur local qui veut prendre le contrôle du pétrole situé sous la réserve des Indiens.

programme.title: Journey of the Chili Pepper Ep.2
programme.desc: In China, the chili pepper is an indispensable winter ingredient. Since its arrival in the Ming dynasty, the spicy staple has been reshaping Chinese food culture. programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Killer instincts plus intelligence ensures survival in the most imaginative ways. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we’ll get to see how the cute dolphin is actually a highly cunning pack hunter who uses all the tools around it to successfully devour prey.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Battles for survival play out every day in the animal kingdom. For the majority of animals, each battle is an uncertainty. But for a fortunate few, the odds are tilted much more in their favor.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: They are purr-fect predators. They move with slow purpose. But attack in violent bursts. They are cats, big cats to be precise. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we will meet three of the most magnificent.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Some animals simply take your breath away. Majestic in so many ways, they move with grace and attack with style. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we meet three majestic animals.

programme.title: Anaconda - The Silent Killer
programme.desc: Few snakes are feared more and understood less than the anaconda. The film shows the journey into remote and uncharted parts of the Amazon rainforest to find the truth behind the mythical beast. Lush green forests abound with colorful toucans, noisy howler monkeys, strange tapirs, and vibrant Amazon Indian tribes. But hiding in the dense vegetation and murky swamps is also the biggest and most powerful snake in the world: the anaconda.

programme.title: Last Devils
programme.desc: Tasmanian Devils are the world's largest carnivorous marsupials and they are only found in Tasmania. Through hundreds of hours of filming in the wild, we reveal how fights over food are a carefully choreographed ritual, we witness the seemingly brutal mating process, see tiny young developing inside their mother's pouch, and visit wild devil pups play-fighting and hunting as they prepare for life in the outside world.

programme.title: Inhabit: A permaculture Perspective
programme.desc: Inhabit: A Permaculture Perspective explores the many environmental issues facing us today and examines solutions that are being applied using the ecological design process called "permaculture"; a design method and philosophy of life with great potential for solving issues related to agriculture, economics and governance. 'Inhabit' provides an intimate look at permaculture peoples and practices ranging from rural, suburban and urban landscapes. This beautifully made documentary presents a vast array of projects, concepts and translates the diversity of permaculture into something that can be understood by an equally diverse audience. For those familiar, it will be a call to action and a glimpse into what's possible. For those unfamiliar, it will be an introduction to a new way of being and a new way of relating to the Earth. For everyone, it will be a reminder that humans are capable of being planetary healing forces. Audience Favorite Princeton Environmental Film Festival 2015. Audience Choice Award EFFY Environmental Film Festival Yale 2015. Official Selections 2015: Food + Farm Film Fest SF, G2 Green Earth Film Festival, FICMA, Life Sciences Film Festival Prague, American Conservation Film Festival, Finger Lakes Environmental Film Festival, ITSA Back to Nature Film Festival & Crossroads Festival for Documentary Film and Discourse.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Nigel explores almost every type of environment in China, climbing steep forested slopes and even wading into a sea cave to track down his top ten. But which is number one?

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Costa Rica has two venomous snakes for every hectare of land, including some of the world's most feared tropical snakes. Which of these kings of the jungle will make it to the top of Nigel's list?

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: The USA is the land of the rattlesnake – there are over 30 species of rattler found here. But what's the deadliest serpent in the country?

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: With almost 2000 snakebites causing 250 deaths every year, South Africa is a hotspot for deadly snakes, with some of the most feared serpents in the world. But what's the most deadly?

programme.title: Africa: The Serengeti
programme.desc: Chronicles a spectacle that few humans have ever witnessed, the Great Migration, taking viewers on a journey with over 1.5 million animals as they travel more than 500 miles across the Serengeti plains in Tanzania and Kenya.

programme.title: Pharm to Table
programme.desc: How far would you go, to know what's in your food? As we go about our daily lives, few of us stop to wonder what our food is really made of. Taylor Lancastor travels 2800 miles on foot, to defend our right to know, and discover the truth of what we are being fed.

programme.title: Adventure Ocean Quest: Fragile Meditarranean
programme.desc: Many of the Mediterranean's coastal waters around harbour cities like Marseille were polluted mercilessly in the past, and much of the local reef life died. Now there is change in the air: pollution has been reduced and artificial reefs encourage wildlife to return. Frederic will carry out wildlife population surveys here and oceanographer Sandrine Ruiton hopes that his results will be exceptionally accurate, since noiseless freediving is much less invasive than conventional diving methods.

programme.title: Xploration Nature Knows Best
programme.desc: Everything uses energy but humans are the only species destroying our planet to create it. Host Danni Washington will discover that not only do all other organisms have better means of gathering energy, but by studying their eyes, their fins, and the ways they move we can find ways to improve solar power, wind power, and even kinetic power!

programme.title: Xploration Nature Knows Best
programme.desc: One of the first instances of bio-inspiration was Velcro influenced by the sticky burrs of the burdock plant. In this episode, host Danni Washington takes a fascinating and fun look at Velcro and other ways inventors have “stuck” with nature including robots that can scale walls or pick-up any object thanks to bugs and chameleons, suction cups inspired by one sucky fish, and an innovation based on the holy-grail of all adhesively-inclined animals… the gecko!

programme.title: Xploration Nature Knows Best
programme.desc: Helicopters took a lot of their early inspiration from one of nature’s most efficient fliers in the dragonfly and host Danni Washington’s going to take one for a spin to see exactly how! She’ll also take a look at how this insect and the wings of owls continue to inspire helicopters and how another one of the helicopter’s early influences, the maple seed, has inspired one of the world’s coolest new unmanned aerial vehicles.

programme.title: Xploration Nature Knows Best
programme.desc: While inventors have been looking toward nature as inspiration for centuries, this science is just starting to come into it’s own and was recently given a name… Biomimicry! Join Danni Washington as we visit all the new places where this science is taking hold, from schools, to zoos, to national conventions like the USA Science and Engineering Festival in Washington D.C.!

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Alexander the Great…Cleopatra, Queen of Egypt…Vlad III Dracul, Prince of Romania…the legacy of these historical icons live on in our modern day culture, but the mysterious circumstances that surround their deaths and conflicting reports of their final resting places have inspired worldwide investigation and unleashed a furious hunt to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Ancient architecture stands as a lasting testimony to human achievement, a visual reflection of the cultural needs and shifting beliefs of civilizations at different points in time. Archeologists avidly study the ancient architecture of the past – temples, buildings and monuments – to reveal clues about the ancient civilizations that created them and understand how past innovation has helped shape the construction of our modern-day world.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: The unexplained appearance of geometric shapes in various locations around the face of the Earth has baffled archaeologists, scientists and researchers alike. These puzzling designs form mysterious figures and alignments that suggest an important purpose, but leave behind more questions than answers, a riddle of origin that buries scholars under mountains of speculative theory and drives their search for scientific proof.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: From the beginning of recorded time, humans have sought to understand the complex ecosystems within which we thrive and survive. The way we understand our physical bodies, the natural world that surrounds us, and our social structures has evolved over the centuries, and the evolution has been documented.

programme.title: Last Devils
programme.desc: Tasmanian Devils are the world's largest carnivorous marsupials and they are only found in Tasmania. Through hundreds of hours of filming in the wild, we reveal how fights over food are a carefully choreographed ritual, we witness the seemingly brutal mating process, see tiny young developing inside their mother's pouch, and visit wild devil pups play-fighting and hunting as they prepare for life in the outside world.

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: The lions attempt to dig a stubborn warthog out of his hole, while an influx of volunteers have arrived and Nathan instructs them with an induction talk on how to treat, walk and cope with lions. Laili notches up another triumph as she catches an African hare.

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: We get a first peek at the adorable additions in the denning enclosure. Lewa and Laili take their hunting skills to a new level and tackle a kudu, and we find out what Rae’s doing with hyena poo! Also, Kwali takes a nasty bite to the cheek. Can she hang onto her prize?

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: Penya and Paza encounter a python; the adorable cubs go on their first bush outing; Lewa and Laili keep the zebra on their toes. Meanwhile, the research team have more experiments for the Ngamo lions.

programme.title: Animal Kingdom: A Tale of Six Families
programme.desc: Animal Kingdom is a stunning exploration into just what makes our natural world so spectacular. An educational journey from A-Z, the film introduces junior audiences to animals from all over the world; and explores the ways in which we can help to protect them. Across frozen snowy forests, under scorching African Sun, and into the darkest depths of the ocean, the film will break down why animals are the way they are and answer the simple but important questions that form the basis of our knowledge about the animal world.

programme.title: Journey to Space
programme.desc: In the past half century, humans have punched through the stratosphere, walked on the moon, and lived continuously in orbit. In the coming decades, our unquenchable curiosity will take our species beyond the cradle of Earth to touch the face of another world. Strap in for the next giant leap. Next stop ... Mars!

programme.title: Ocean Origins
programme.desc: 4 billion years in the ocean, from the very beginning of life up to the incredible moment when the first vertebrate emerged onto dry land and opened a path to the conquest of the continents, Origins of Life examines the fascinating sea-creatures that are still alive today.

programme.title: Australia: Land Beyond Time
programme.desc: Stunning inside look at a land more like another planet than another country. Includes a rare natural event that happens only once every hundred years: the formation of a giant inland ocean out of nowhere in the middle of the harshest desert outback.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: The marine world is home to an eclectic mix of creatures each with their own unique survival skills, voracious hunting tactics and fascinating adaptations. We begin with the barracuda.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: It is easy to overlook the tiny in stature, but sometimes the smallest should be the most feared. On this episode of Killer Instinct, three big little assassins prove that size has nothing to do with survival.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Apex predators sit comfortably atop the food chain. Cunning as they are large, they rule over their environments. Large and in-charge, their speed and bulk deliver a knockout blow.

programme.title: Piège en haute couture
programme.desc: Sophie (Jeri Ryan), créatrice de mode respectueuse de l'environnement et défenseur des femmes dans le monde entier, est sur le point de lancer sa ligne de vêtements très attendue et d'ouvrir son premier magasin phare lorsqu'une de ses employées est retrouvée assassinée.

programme.title: Amour et préméditation
programme.desc: Une ancienne avocate de la défense, qui travaille maintenant comme avocate spécialisée dans les divorces, est invitée à représenter le mari de sa meilleure amie, qui a été accusé de son meurtre.

programme.title: Amour, Romance & Chocolat
programme.desc: Emma et le chocolatier Luc concourent pour le titre de chocolatier royal de Belgique. La beauté et le romantisme de Bruges inspirent des combinaisons de chocolat uniques, mais leur projet gagnera-t-il sans qu'ils ne perdent leur cœur ?

programme.title: L'Édition de l'Amour
programme.desc: La rédactrice beauté d’un magazine féminin convainc un photographe prometteur de prétendre être son petit ami lorsque son ex se fiance avec une autre. Ensemble, ils devront collaborer pour redorer la réputation déclinante du magazine.

programme.title: Mes Deux amours
programme.desc: Hadrien se lance à la recherche de la femme qu'il aime, Barbara, qui a disparu sans lui donner de nouvelles. Personne ne veut entendre ses angoisses sauf un autre homme, qui affirme à Hadrien que la femme de sa vie est la sienne... La rencontre entre les deux amants de Barbara a lieu à l'endroit où elle a été aperçue pour la dernière fois : la bergerie dont elle a hérité de sa mère. Hadrien Darcourt est arrivé en 4x4, Emmanuel Devailly, en stop. Hadrien est encore en costume, Emmanuel est déjà en tenue de campagne. Hadrien a fait appel à la gendarmerie, Emmanuel à son instinct. Bref, tout les oppose, mais ils aiment tous deux Barbara Cantarella, 45 ans, grand reporter

programme.title: La messagère
programme.desc: Après avoir frôlé la mort, Ellie Daly est terrifiée de réaliser qu'elle est capable de voir et de parler avec les morts. De retour chez elle, elle est abordée par le fantôme furieux d'une femme morte, qui accuse le mystérieux et séduisant nouveau voisin d'Ellie de son propre meurtre brutal.

programme.title: La dernière chance
programme.desc: Un agent du FBI doit négocier avec une femme qui prend un hôpital en otage afin de mettre la main sur un médicament expérimental.

programme.title: Présomption d'innocence
programme.desc: Une femme est reconnue coupable d'avoir tué son petit ami et sa meilleure amie dans le feu de la passion bien qu'elle ait été défendue par un avocat de renom. Elle s'enfuit après le procès afin de découvrir qui l'a piégée.

programme.title: Une Mère Diabolique
programme.desc: Lorsque Allison, 14 ans, perd son père dans un accident d'avion, trois ans après la mort de sa mère adoptive, elle est dévastée. Lors des funérailles, elle est choquée de rencontrer sa mère biologique, Jessica. Elle et sa demi-sœur Sydni seront encore plus choquées de découvrir que Jessica a un plan infâme pour contrôler les 40 millions de dollars dont Allison doit hériter.

programme.title: Une Pluie sans Fin
programme.desc: Un homme licencié d'une aciérie veut désespérément traquer un tueur en série dans une petite ville du sud de la Chine.

programme.title: Habib, la grande aventure
programme.desc: La vie d’Habib, un jeune acteur bruxellois issu de l’immigration marocaine, qui a l’opportunité de jouer le rôle principal dans un film sur la vie de François d’Assise.

programme.title: L'Histoire de l'Amour
programme.desc: The story of a long-lost book that mysteriously reappears and connects an old man searching for his son with a girl seeking a cure for her mother's loneliness.

programme.title: La mémoire de mon pays
programme.desc: Langston Whitfield est journaliste au Washington Post. Son rédacteur en chef l’envoie en Afrique du Sud pour couvrir les audiences de la Commission Vérité et Réconciliation, où les auteurs de meurtres et de tortures des deux camps durant l’Apartheid sont invités à se présenter et à affronter leurs victimes. En disant la vérité sans fard et en exprimant des remords, ils peuvent obtenir l’amnistie. Les profondes blessures de l’Apartheid peuvent-elles être guéries par la réconciliation ?

programme.title: Troppa grazia
programme.desc: Lucia, mère célibataire, lutte pour trouver le bon équilibre entre sa fille adolescente, une histoire d'amour compliquée et sa carrière de géomètre. Son avenir professionnel est compromis lorsqu'elle réalise que la future construction d'un immeuble ambitieux s'avère dangereuse pour l'environnement en raison des cartes topographiques inexactes du conseil municipal.
